business.text: Lam Research makes etch and deposition equipment used to build memory and logic chips. It is the leader in the tools that matter most for 3D NAND and high bandwidth memory.

headline: Quality rank 25 of 150, score 84. Bucket: compounder. Price 292.66 USD on 2026-09-04. Forward P/E 25.3 vs own 4 year median 30.1 (-16%). EV/EBITDA 42.2. -34% from 52 week high, -33% from all time high. Next fiscal year EPS estimate moved +20.1% in 90 days. Short interest 2.5% of float. Next earnings 2026-10-21. earnings_text.text: Q4 fiscal 2026 (late July 2026): record revenue $6.72 billion up 30%, EPS $1.82 vs $1.68 expected, September quarter guided to $8.1 billion plus or minus $400 million with operating margin 39.5%. Stock rose 8% after hours after falling 7% during the day. The December quarter is expected to see gross margin dip to 48.5% on mix and tariffs.

read.why: Guidance changes, tone, and what management stepped around cannot be parsed out of a screen. They need someone to read the 8-K exhibit and the call. The research note for this name covers the last two reports, and its text is above.

thesis.why_on_the_list: Compounder bucket, rank 25, and a near miss for the cyclical bucket at 33% off its high. Forward P/E 25.3 vs a 30.1 median, next year's EPS estimate up 20% in 90 days.
thesis.business_quality: ROIC 37%, net cash, gross margin 52%. Management raised the 2026 wafer fab equipment outlook to the low $150 billion range. Export controls are about a $600 million revenue headwind for calendar 2026.
thesis.verdict: Buy on pullback, November tranche, small. Buy zone $250 to $290. Conviction 3 of 5. KLA is the preferred semi equipment holding; this is the second.
thesis.action: Buy on pullback, November tranche, small

logged.thesis: Record quarter, 20% sequential growth guided, estimates up 20% in 90 days. Second semi equipment name, kept small.
logged.wrong_if: 2027 equipment spending guided down, or a close under $215.

risks.bear_case: Memory capex is the most volatile spending line in all of technology, and Lam is the most memory exposed of the big three. A 20% sequential revenue jump is what peaks look like. The stock has already tripled from its lows.
killers: calendar 2027 WFE guided down, December quarter guidance below the September quarter, or gross margin under 47%

wrong_if.text: 2027 equipment spending guided down, or a close under $215.

own_history.caveat: The median is taken at four fiscal year ends, so it is a four-point median. That is a thin basis for 'cheap against its own history' and it says nothing about whether the old multiple was deserved.

drawdown.caveat: The all-time high is the highest closing price; the 52-week high is an intraday high. They are not on the same basis, and the drawdown from the all-time high is therefore understated.

price_basis.note: The drawdowns and the multiple-versus-median above were computed inside the price screen from its own last close, which is not quite the price shown at the top of this page: the two come from different passes of the pipeline and differ by a fraction of a percent. Neither is wrong; they are just not the same number.

peers.reasoning: Neither its multiple nor its quality separates it from its peers, and the two are close to each other. Most of the list is here, and that is the honest answer for most of the list.
peers.why: The own-history comparison above says nothing about whether the old multiple was deserved. This asks a different question: where does this name sit among its peers on price, and where does it sit among them on the things a price is supposed to reflect.

written_view.text: At $292.66 and 25.3x forward. September quarter guidance of $8.1 billion revenue and $2.15 EPS implies an $8.60 annual run rate, so about 34x run rate with estimates rising. Same shape as KLA: bear (2028 downturn) 16x on $6 is about $96; base 22x on $10 is $220; bull 26x on $12 is $312.
